sloka: ततः संयुध्यमानेन विष्टब्धो न व्यकम्पत ।तदाप्रभृति यक्षो ऽसौ पार्श्वमौलिरिति स्मृतः ।सन्नादः सुमहान्राजंस्तस्मिन्शैले ऽभ्यवर्तत ।। ७.१५.१५ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ saṁyudhyamānena viṣṭabdho na vyakampata ।tadāprabhṛti yakṣo 'sau pārśvamauliriti smṛtaḥ ।sannādaḥ sumahānrājaṁstasminśaile 'bhyavartata ।। 7.15.15 ॥

translations.english: Then, though fighting, he remained firm and did not tremble, and from that time onwards, that Yaksha became known as Pārśvamauli (one with a side-tilted crown); O King, a very great roar resounded on that mountain.
